.. _cli-config:

Config
~~~~~~

The :func:`config <cli.config_command>` command displays the application's
configuration values as JSON. Sensitive keys (containing ``SECRET``,
``PASSWORD``, ``TOKEN``, or ``KEY``) are masked for security.

.. code-block:: text

    $ flask config
    {
      "DATABASE_URI": "sqlite:////tmp/test.db",
      "SECRET_KEY": "***",
      ...
    }

def test_config_command(app):
    app.config["SECRET_KEY"] = "secret"
    app.config["PASSWORD_HASH"] = "password"
    app.config["API_TOKEN"] = "token"
    app.config["DATABASE_URL"] = "url"
    app.config["DEBUG"] = True

    with app.test_cli_runner().isolation() as (out, _):
        with app.app_context():
            config_command()
    
    config = json.loads(out.getvalue())
    assert config["SECRET_KEY"] == "***"
    assert config["PASSWORD_HASH"] == "***"
    assert config["API_TOKEN"] == "***"
    assert config["DATABASE_URL"] == "url"
    assert config["DEBUG"] is True
